tei:div.tei:p: dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i cha lag ma mo rbod gtong sgrub pa srid gsum zil gnon bzhugs/ ༄༅/ bcom ldan 'das mngon rtogs rgyal po he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// ma mo rbod gtong sgrub 'dod pas// dur khrod chen po'i sa phyogs su// dkyil 'khor phyi dor byas nas ni/ khrag chen dag gis chag chag gdab// thal chan gyis ni hūm̐ bris la// dmigs pa'i rten du mkhas pas bzhag /dpal chen 'dus pa'i las gzhung gi 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang cher/ zhes pa'i mtshams su/ zhing chen zhing chung gdan steng duḥ bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ sku ni mthing nag 'jigs tshul canaḥ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhalaḥ rdo rje khyung dang sbrul zhags g.yasaḥ bhan+dha zhing g.yas ga'u g.yonaḥ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyanaḥ srid pa'i ma mo zhabs bzhis gziraḥ yum chen kun tu bzang mo niḥ bzhi zur zhabs brgyad phyogs mtshams gnonaḥ mkha' bzhi bde klong gcig tu 'khrilaḥ dbu gcig zhal lnga srid pa gsalaḥ pha rol phyin drug phyag rgya 78)yisaḥ rdo rje dril bu sbrul zhags dang ཿ bhan+dha bdud rtsi g.yang gzhi bsnamasaḥ sna tshogs 'dzin 'gyur ba'i sku mdog laḥ gnyis med bde bas yab dang sbyoraḥ rtag pa'i rgyal mo rnam pa lngaḥ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgradaḥ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po naḥ rigs kyi mtshan ma so sor 'dzinaḥ de bzhin g.yon pa thod pa'oḥ rnam snang gsal dang 'od gsal 'baraḥ gnyan gsal 'bar dang yang gsal g.yosaḥ bkrag gsal 'bar zhes bya ba niḥ ming gi mtha' dang yang dag ldanaḥ shar gyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong maḥ sku mdog dkar mo shel ltar dgaḥ dgra s+t+wa dang ni btun shing btegs ཿ seng ge mchog chen tha mas snyodaḥ lho yi mkha' 'gro ba glang gdong ཿ sku mdog sngon mo 'bar ba laḥ me dbal dbyug pa'i tho ba dang ཿ tha ma stag mo zhing chung snyodaḥ nub kyi mkha' 'gro pud ka'i mdogaḥ sku mdog dmar mo mdzes tshul canaḥ

zhags pa dang ni tri shu laḥ lce spyang dang ni zhing chung snyodaḥ byang 79) gi mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i mchuḥ sku mdog ljang gu 'od du 'baraḥ dbyug to rdo rje rgyu phreng 'dzinaḥ spyang mo'i kha ru zhing chung snyodaḥ nam mkha'i mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i mchuḥ sku mdog gtso ma'i gser ltar gdangasaḥ rgyal mtshan dang ni spu gri 'dzinaḥ tha ma 'ug pa zhing chung snyodaḥ srid pa bde 'gro khams gsum yumaḥ sku mdog mthing ka 'bar ba laḥ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgradaḥ 'khor lo rin chen g.yang gzhi rdebaḥ thod khrag tshe bum lcags kyu thogasaḥ dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng canaḥ zangs lcags dkar nag zhags pa 'phenaḥ rdo rje nyi ma mdog dkar zhing ཿ lag na shel gyi spu gri thogasaḥ rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bya baḥ sngon mo thod pa thod khrag 'dzinaḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi dmar mo niḥ lag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzinaḥ ljang nag rdo rje srid gsum maḥ lag na zhing lpags rgyal mtshan thogasaḥ dkar mo srid pa'i rgyan byed maḥ lag na srid pa'i zhags pa thogasaḥ sngon mo dbyings phyug rgyal mo niḥ lag 80)na zhing gi dbyug pa'oḥ dmar mo bdag nyid chen mo niḥ lag na zhing gi rgyu zhags 'dzinaḥ ser mo chen mo gcig pu maḥ lag na mi yi g.yang gzhi rdebaḥ dkar mo chen mo mig gcig maḥ lag na bhan+dha zlum po thogasaḥ mthing nag chen mo mche ba canaḥ lag na bhan+dha sul mang bsnamasaḥ dmar mo dbang gi rgyal mo niḥ lag na bhan+dha lcang lo canaḥ ser mo chen mo las mkhan maḥ lag na bhan+dha rgya gram thogasaḥ srid pa'i ma mo chags byed maḥ mthing nag mi snying rlon pa thodaḥ 'dzin te de bzhin cha snyoms maḥ dmar mo thod pa khrag gis bkang ཿ 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug maḥ mdog sngon bdud kyi khram bam thogasaḥ e ka dza ti ral gcig maḥ dkar mo kha ṭ+waṃ ka mi roḥ gling bzhi kun gyi spyi phud niḥ dkar mo lcags kyu 'od phreng canaḥ rin chen srid legs mdog sngon moḥ

lag na g.yu yi ga'u 'oḥ pad+ma gar dbang le brgan mdogaḥ 81) thod pa khrag bkang thugs kar 'dzinaḥ de bzhin rdo rje gar dbang phyugaḥ ser mo thod khrag lcang lo canaḥ har ti dkar mo chen mo niḥ lag na me yi dkyil 'khor thogasaḥ dun+tiṃ nag mo khro mo'i gzugasaḥ lag na sa yi dkyil 'khor 'dzinaḥ dngos po'i cha byad dmar po laḥ lag na chu yi dkyil 'khor thogasaḥ gru ting ser mo gser gyi mdogaḥ lag na rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'dzinaḥ bdag nyid chen mo gcig pu maḥ dbyings phyug rgyan gyi rgyal mo niḥ zhing gi rgyu zhags g.yang gzhi rdebaḥ srad bu'i zhags pas thod pa 'dzinaḥ skam pa mo dang phor thogs maḥ g.yang gzhi mo dang za ba dang ཿ gsod byed mo dang za ba moḥ de bzhin dri ma bsnams byed maḥ srin mo chen mo 'di dag kyang ཿ dkar sngo dmar dang ser ba'i gzugasaḥ thod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa'oḥ shar gyi dkar mo mche gtsigs maḥ lag na bhan+dha dkar po thogasaḥ lho yi nag mo kha 'byams maḥ lag na bhan+dha sngon mo 82) thogasaḥ nub kyi dmar mo mchu 'jib maḥ lag na bhan+dha dmar po thogasaḥ byang gi ser mo rkang ldag maḥ lag na bhan+dha ser mo thogasaḥ gling bzhi mgyogs pa lha yi sring ཿ dkar mo rdo rje rtse gsum thogasaḥ mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i sring ཿ sngon mo mi thod dbyug pa thogasaḥ dmar mo g.yag thod klu yi sring ཿ dmar mo sbrul nag zhags pa thogasaḥ nag mo ster thogs gnod sbyin sring ཿ ser mo ne'u le'i rkyal pa thogasaḥ yang gab bzhi dang sbas ma bzhiḥ gdong mo bzhi dang phung gsum maḥ gsang ba ma gsum pho nya gsumaḥ ro gām gsum la sogs pa'iḥ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas gsal bar bskyedaḥ hūm̐ḥ rag las shar ba'i dpal chen tshogasaḥ zhes sogs dpal chen gzhung ltar la/ spyan 'dren gyi mal du/ hūm̐ḥ rnam dag mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rig pa'i dbyings la skye ba med mod kyang ཿ skye ba'i cho 'phrul ma mo'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ 83) hoḥ bzhugs gsol sogs gzhung ltar la/ bstod pa rgyas pa ma mo 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud ltar ram/ bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ bcom ldan che mchog he ru kaḥ kun tu bzang mo mu kha leḥ gnyis su med pa'i 'phro 'du lasaḥ byang chub sems kyi sprin chen tshogasaḥ ye shes ma mo 'char zhing 'phroḥ las kyi ma mo rbod cing gtong ཿ sprul pa'i ma mo mchod cing lhaḥ mngon rdzogs yab yum sku la bstodaḥ yum chen rtag pa'i rgyal mo lngaḥ dbyings kyi yum la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ye shes rje mo bcu bzhi dang ཿ sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sogasaḥ ma mo chen mo 'di rnams kyisaḥ ye shes mngon du brnyes byas kyang ཿ phrin las tshogs kyi gtso mo steḥ thugs kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba medaḥ gsung gi grags stong chos kyi gsung ཿ sku ni sna tshogs sprul pa'i skuḥ yon tan ma lus phun sum tshogs: phrin las drag shul gdug pa 'dulaḥ res 'ga' 'jig rten srid pa'i tshogasaḥ res 'ga' gab sbas gsang ba'i tshulaḥ res 'ga' rnal 'byor grogs 84) kyi tshulaḥ res 'ga' drag po sngags kyi tshulaḥ kun kyang dur khrod chas kyi rgyanaḥ ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ dzab ni/ bdag nyid bla med he ru ka'iḥ nga rgyal brtan por bzung byas nasaḥ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'iḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad kunaḥ rang dbang med par las la 'dzudaḥ gang dang gang la dmigs pa yisaḥ las rnams de dag thams cad kunaḥ skad cig rtsam gyis 'grub par gyuraḥ oṃ gu h+ye dzñā na shṝ he ru ka gu h+ya dzñā na kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃḥ ma ma yo gi ni ru lu lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ dang phaṭa kyis thog mtha' brten// bar na bco brgyad grong gnas pa// ma mo 'khor bcas srog snying yin// phyi ma phyi ma'i rgyud las/ ā+oṃ ye shes lnga/ gu h+ye dzñā nashṝ he ru ka yab kyi snying po/ gu h+ye dzñān kro dhi shwa ri dbyings kyi yum drug gi snying po/

ma ma yo gi ni rnal 'byor ma rje mo bcu gnyis kyi snying po/ ru lu ru lu sman mo bcu gnyis kyi snying po/ bh+yo dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi snying poḥ hūm̐ dbang du bsdu ba/ phaṭaḥlas la 'gyed pa ste/ ma mo chen mo bdun cu 85) rtsa lnga'i snying por brtan pa'o/ zhes gsungs so// ma mo rnams kyi zhal du yang*// bdud rtsi blug la las la bkye// rbod gtong las rnams 'grub par 'gyur// rjes kyi las rim gzhung bzhin no// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las ma mo rbod gtong bsgrub pa'i le'u bcu drug pa zur bkol 'di'ang ma hā shṝ saṅgas so// dge'o// 86)
